column1: # Who may commit what in /workspace/notes. Enforced by bin/notes-commit and .githooks/commit-msg.
# path-glob<TAB>owners. First match wins; * in a glob spans directories. Owners: bot names, * = any bot,
# {stem} = the bot named by the file name (state/<bot>.md), @d-id = appended through bin/d-id by any bot.
